out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Plan & Specifications Submission - Remodeling, Change of Type, Change of Operation
violations.observation: The permit holder did not submit plans or specifications for remodeling/renovation, change in type of establishment leading to extensive menu change, and/or change in layout/equipment. Observed installed soda machine/ice dispenser in dining area.
violations.corrective_action: Submit an amendment in PLUS for installed equipment to be reviewed and approved by the plan review team.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed almond milk at 44F in 1 DR UC (#5), observed cut lettuce at 44F in WIC (#1), observed breaded raw chicken at 65F in 2 DR PREP (#3)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded almond milk and cut lettuce, CFM moved breaded raw chicken to freezer to cool to 37F.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. Observed spray bottle of degreaser with label smudged.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. CFM relabelled spray bottle.

violations.title: Food Thermometer, Repair and Calibration
violations.observation: The food temperature measuring device was found out of calibration in the range of use. Observed digital thermometer out of calibration. Thermometer reading 12F compared to calibrated EHS thermometer reading 32F in ice water.
violations.corrective_action: Food thermometers shall be calibrated in accordance with manufacturer's specifications as necessary to ensure their accuracy. It is suggested that food thermometers be calibrated at least once a week in a cup completely filled with ice and cold water to a temperature of 32F or calibrated in a pot of boiling water at 212F. CFM will use analog thermometer that was found to be calibrated.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottle of oil, shaker of salt.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will label secondary containers with food name.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food. Observed employee wearing wrist watch.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CFM will discuss with employees that wrist watches are not permitted to be worn.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: OBSERVED WET WIPING CLOTHS IN QUATERNARY AMMONIA SOLUTION AT A CONCENTRATION OF 0PPM.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM DISCARDED SOLUTION IN BUCKETS AND REFILLED WITH SANITIZER SOLUTION TESTED AT 200-400PPM.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items Storage and Handling
violations.observation: OBSERVED SINGLE-SERVICE KNIVES AND SPOONS AT CUSTOMER SELF-SERVICE AREA WITH LIP-CONTACT SURFACE FACING OUTWARD.
violations.corrective_action: Single-service items and cleaned/sanitized utensils shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed so that contamination of food and lip contact surfaces are prevented. CFM WILL ADJUST UTENSILS SO THAT HANDLE IS FACING OUTWARD.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: FLAT PIECE OF METAL USED FOR SMASHING BURGER PATTIES.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. EHS RECOMMENDED PURCHASING FOOD SAFE TOOL TO USE INSTEAD OF UNAPPROVED METAAL PIECE.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 DR PREP OBSERVED AT 72F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM WILL NOT STORE TCS FOODS IN UNIT UNTIL REPAIRED AND ABLE TO MAINTAIN 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: EXTERIOR OF HOOD. EXTERIOR OF HOOD VENTS OBSERVED WITH ACCUMULATION OF DUST AND GREASE.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. CFM WILL CLEAN HOODS.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Refuse Areas & Enclosures Maintained Clean
violations.observation: Trash and litter were observed adjacent to the refuse container outside the facility. OBSERVED ACCUMULATION OF TRASH AND LEAF LITTER SURROUNDING SHARED COMPACTORS.
violations.corrective_action: A storage area and enclosure for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be maintained free of unnecessary items and kept clean. CLEAN AREA AROUND COMPACTORS.

violations.title: Receptacles, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: OBSERVED OUTDOOR GREASE BIN WITH ACCUMULATION OF GREASE ON EXTERIOR OF UNIT AND ON GROUND SURROUNDING UNIT.
violations.corrective_action: Soiled receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent them from developing a buildup of soil or becoming attractants for insects and rodents. REQUEST NEW GREASE BIN AND/OR CLEAN GREASE BIN AND SURROUNDING AREA OF GREASE. ENSURE CLEANING AND DISPOSAL OF GREASE FOLLOWS APPLICABLE REGULATIONS AND LAWS.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Protective Shielding on Light Bulbs
violations.observation: OBSERVED CEILING LIGHT ABOVE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK/OFFICE AREA WITHOUT PROTECTIVE COVERING.
violations.corrective_action: PURCHASE SHATTER-PROOF BULBS OR ADD LIGHT BULB TUBE GUARD TO BULBS.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. Observed no CFM present during inspection. One employee had an expired CFM card from 2024.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. A CFM must be present during all hours of operation. Additional employees must obtain CFM certificate to ensure coverage of all hours of operation. A follow up inspection will occur on or around 10 days to verify a CFM is present.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: Observed nocovered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall.
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. Purchase trash can with lid for women’s restroom.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed missing ceiling light cover above main cook area. Observed loose ceiling light cover above office desk area.
violations.corrective_action: Replace ceiling light cover above main cook area. Secure loose ceiling light cover above desk area.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: observed raw chicken on shelf above raw beef in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). CFM moved chicken to bottom shelf.
